name: pipeline-limit-fill
description: Pending-order queue: a LIMIT BUY entry resolves one tick after submission and fills AT the limit price, tagged MAKER; the exit is a plain market SELL, tagged TAKER. Maker/taker fee model (maker 0.001, taker 0.002), RECEIVED leg, funding 1000. Tick script: t1 last=105 -> the strategy emits a BuySignal with orderKind=limit and price=100 (enqueued, not filled on this tick); t2 last=99 -> the pending order resolves BEFORE the strategy sees t2 (99 <= 100) and fills AT 100 as MAKER: baseGross = 10, feeBase = 10*0.001 = 0.01, baseNet = 9.99; t3 last=110 -> the strategy emits a market SellSignal, TAKER: quoteGross = 9.99*110 = 1098.9, feeQuote = 1098.9*0.002 = 2.1978, quoteNet = 1096.7022. Deliberately the same arithmetic as pipeline-asymmetric-fees.json (buy 0.1%, sell 0.2%): this fixture pins that a LIMIT fill routes as MAKER end to end through the pending-order queue, not that the numbers are novel.

ticks.action: resolves pending limit buy (99<=100), fills AT 100, tagged MAKER
strategy emits SellSignal orderKind=market price=110, tagged TAKER
